title: fix: comprehensive view component spec UI protocol compliance audit
body:
`ViewType`, view-related Zod validators, and component registrations were out of sync with the `@objectstack/spec/ui` ListView type enum and their own TS interfaces.

### ViewType enum

Spec defines ListView `type` as `grid | kanban | gallery | calendar | timeline | gantt | map`. ObjectUI's `ViewType` was missing `gallery` and `gantt`.

```typescript
// before
export type ViewType = 'list' | 'detail' | 'grid' | 'kanban' | 'calendar' | 'timeline' | 'map';

// after
export type ViewType = 'list' | 'detail' | 'grid' | 'kanban' | 'calendar' | 'timeline' | 'map' | 'gallery' | 'gantt';
```

### Zod ↔ TS interface drift in `views.zod.ts`

- **`DetailViewFieldSchema.type`** — Zod had 10 values, TS interface had 21. Added missing data-oriented types: `number`, `currency`, `percent`, `boolean`, `select`, `lookup`, `master_detail`, `email`, `url`, `phone`, `user`
- **`DetailViewFieldSchema`** — Missing properties: `options`, `reference_to`, `reference_field`, `currency`
- **`DetailViewSectionSchema`** — Missing properties: `showBorder`, `headerColor`

### plugin-view ViewSwitcher

Added `gallery` (`Images` icon) and `gantt` (`GanttChartSquare` icon) to `DEFAULT_VIEW_LABELS` and `DEFAULT_VIEW_ICONS` maps.

### plugin-list component registrations

The `list-view` and `list` component registrations had invalid `viewType` enum values (`'list'` and `'chart'` are not valid spec types) and were missing `'gallery'`, `'timeline'`, `'gantt'`, and `'map'`. Fixed to match spec's `grid | kanban | gallery | calendar | timeline | gantt | map`.

### plugin-detail component registrations

- **`detail-view`** registration was missing 8 inputs that exist on `DetailViewSchema`: `layout`, `columns`, `loading`, `backUrl`, `editUrl`, `deleteConfirmation`, `header`, `footer`.
- **`detail-section`** registration was missing `showBorder` and `headerColor` inputs that are already implemented in the `DetailSection.tsx` component and TS interface.
